_about: Investor context read by every skill. Edit this file to adapt the plugin to another country, currency or account type; skills must not hardcode these values.

portfolio._about: Which broker account and watchlist /analyze reads through the portfolio connector. null = auto: the only account matching account.type, and the only watchlist if there is exactly one.

account.name: Investeringssparkonto (Sweden)
account.tax_model: Flat annual standard-yield tax (schablonbeskattning) on the account's capital base. No tax on realised gains or dividends inside the account, and no deduction for losses.
implications: Selling, trimming and rebalancing have no tax cost — decide on investment merit only. Never cite capital gains tax, tax-loss harvesting or holding-period tax benefits.
Tax is charged on the account's value (including cash) regardless of performance, so idle cash still carries the annual tax cost.

Foreign dividends suffer source-country withholding tax (e.g. 15% US with a W-8BEN on file); it can be credited against the ISK tax only up to that year's ISK tax amount. Prefer noting it over assuming it is recoverable.
Instruments must be ISK-eligible: listed on a regulated market or MTF, and offered by the broker for ISK.
Retail investors in the EU/EEA generally cannot buy US-domiciled ETFs (no PRIIPs KID). Use UCITS ETFs or Swedish/European funds instead.

tax_parameters._verify: Rates and allowances change yearly — confirm with Skatteverket before quoting amounts.
tax_parameters.rate_formula: capital base × max(government borrowing rate on 30 Nov of the prior year + 1 percentage point, 1.25%) × 30%

volatility.name: CBOE VIX
volatility.note: No free European volatility index (VSTOXX) is available; VIX is the global risk gauge.

sector_proxies._about: iShares STOXX Europe 600 sector UCITS ETFs on Xetra (EUR). Used for sector leadership; Nasdaq Stockholm is heavy in industrials and banks.

reporting_seasons: Nasdaq Stockholm companies report mainly in late January–February, late April–early May, mid–late July and late October; US companies roughly two to three weeks after quarter end.

position_sizing._about: Percentages, never fixed amounts. Convert to base currency with fx and show both.
position_sizing.min_order_note: Check the broker's minimum commission before recommending small orders (e.g. IBKR Stockholm 0.05%, min 10 SEK; Montrose 0.15%, min 1 SEK).

valuation_defaults.discount_rate: Local 10-year government bond yield for the company's reporting currency (look it up and cite it) + about 5 percentage points equity risk premium, adjusted for size and business risk. State each input.
valuation_defaults.terminal_growth: Do not exceed the long-run inflation target of the reporting currency area (2% for SEK, EUR and USD); default 2%.
